tasks.label: Check Windows DLL
tasks.command: file sample_libretro.dll && x86_64-w64-mingw32-objdump -p sample_libretro.dll | grep 'DLL Name' && x86_64-w64-mingw32-objdump -p sample_libretro.dll | grep -oE 'retro_[a-z_]+' | sort -u

tasks.label: Check Linux .so
tasks.command: file sample_libretro.so && ldd sample_libretro.so && nm -D --defined-only sample_libretro.so | grep -oE 'retro_[a-z_]+' | sort -u && objdump -T sample_libretro.so | grep -oE 'GLIBC_[0-9.]+' | sort -uV | tail -1

tasks.label: Clean
tasks.command: make clean platform=win && make clean platform=unix
